serviceDomains.cadaLinhaLigaUmDominio: Each row links a domain to a container of the stack and the port it listens on. Several domains can point to the same container (different ports: app and admin). Requires the proxy to be active on the server. Each domain's DNS must point to the server. Takes effect on the next Redeploy.
serviceDomains.semDominioOsContainersSo: No domain: the containers only answer inside the environment network (and on the ports the compose file publishes).

appSleepCard.dica: With no traffic for the chosen time, the container is stopped to free memory and CPU. The next request starts it again: the visitor waits a bit longer for that first response (usually 1 to 5 seconds, depending on the app), with no loading page. Stopping it manually does not stick: the next visit starts it again.
appSleepCard.precisaDeDominio: Set a domain to use this option.
